answer: An economic Sybil resistance mechanism employs collateralized vaults to verify agent identity, ensuring active participation without resource hoarding. In the decentralized grove, each verified node bears direct financial liability, rendering fake identities unbankable. This multiplies operational costs, creating high economic friction that renders synthetic fraud mathematically unprofitable for the adversary.
